From: procurement@cumulus.tech

Cc: alisa@marketplace-ops.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Vendor FastPass request: Cumulus Tech marketplace listing

Hi Tessa,

We'd like to accelerate our marketplace listing and procurement lane with Redwood — people here call it a 'FastPass' for new vendors. Can you confirm the PO process and the minimum onboarding packet for AWS, Azure and GCP listings? Immediate asks:

- Which PO template do we need to route?
- Any marketplace-specific requirements (tax forms, regional billing account IDs)?
- Typical SLA/activation lead time once PO is accepted.

We're under a product launch timeline and would appreciate a quick intake path. I can loop in legal if we need to negotiate terms.

— Alex Patterson
Head of Procurement, Cumulus Tech
procurement@cumulus.tech

Attachment: none
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: procurement@cumulus.tech
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, alisa@marketplace-ops.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Vendor FastPass request: Cumulus Tech marketplace listing

Hi Alex — thanks for reaching out. We have a lightweight "FastPass" intake we use for customers that want a fast marketplace-onboarding path. I've attached the vendor-fastpass-checklist.xlsx and a PO template that maps to the three cloud marketplaces. High level:

1) What we need from you to start:
   - Completed vendor-fastpass-checklist.xlsx (basic company & tax info, contact for billing, marketplace account IDs)
   - Signed PO (we accept marketplace PO or direct Redwood PO; see attached Cumulus-PO-template.docx)
   - If listing on AWS Marketplace: include AWS Seller ID and product SKU if available.
   - For Azure/GCP: billing account ID and reseller mapping (if applicable).

2) Routing & timelines
   - If PO uses customer procurement system -> route to our Finance (accounts-payable@redwood.com) and copy your procurement contact + Ben on sales terms.
   - Typical processing: 3–5 business days for finance validation, 5–10 business days for marketplace activation (varies by cloud).

3) Legal & redlines
   - For standard SOW/terms we can accept DocuSign. If legal needs to redline, please send markups to legal@cumulus.tech and loop me; that typically adds ~5 business days.

Next steps: please fill the checklist and return. Ben (cc'd) will confirm pricing SKU/AM binding and Vanessa will run the marketplace activation queue once we have the PO.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
VP, GTM Operations — Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: vendor-fastpass-checklist.xlsx, Cumulus-PO-template.docx

Tessa — quick clarifying Qs from pricing/sales side:

- Are they requesting a metered SaaS listing or a flat-fee AMI/marketplace SKU? If metered we need to coordinate tagging for usage reporting.
- Do we want to propose a 30-day dev activation window with a 90-day go-live milestone?

Alex — can you confirm which SKU type? If you don't have one yet we can provision a placeholder SKU to get them into the activation lane, final SKU & pricing to be reconciled with your PO. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8241 (I've added internal notes).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

- Data residency clause for US-only (we need confirmation of region controls for log retention).
- Audit rights limited to SOC2 artifacts provided over a secure share for 30 days.
- PO net payment terms: Net 45 (Finance will need to accept).

If you can confirm acceptance or provide a counter, we can sign via DocuSign. Also confirm the PO routing address for invoices (we prefer electronic invoicing to ap-invoices@cumulus.tech).
